purpose: Compare six Stage-2 utility functions while holding Stage-1 Sharpe sleeve methodology fixed
benchmark: SPY buy-and-hold from first next-session adjusted open; no benchmark fees

stage1.max_weight_rule: 20% sleeve cap if at least five names; 1/n for three or four names
stage1.candidate_set_rule: current model selections plus union of previous holdings across the six utility portfolios
stage1.prior_weight_seed: Mean-variance portfolio prior holdings at each rebalance

stage2.decision_variable: risky exposure k; final risky weights are k*q
stage2.semivariance_target: zero active return versus the after-cost DGS3MO cash alternative
stage2.cvar_loss: positive shortfall of net portfolio terminal wealth relative to net cash terminal wealth
stage2.log_utility: expected log terminal wealth; no free risk-aversion parameter
stage2.scenario_generation: moving-block bootstrap: construct 697 overlapping contiguous 60-session blocks from the trailing 756 daily returns, then sample 697 blocks with replacement using a date-derived deterministic seed
stage2.scenario_drift_calibration: per-asset multiplicative gross-return scaling to match S06 120-day expected-return forecast
stage2.risk_estimator_note: The existing mean-variance baseline retains S06 252-session sample covariance; downside/tail/expected-utility alternatives evaluate the 756-session bootstrap scenario distribution. This is a comparison of the existing S06 baseline against scenario-based utility formulations, not a perfectly isolated change in utility curvature alone.

expected_return_estimator: S06 trailing 120-session adjusted-close compounded return converted geometrically to 60 sessions
stage1_covariance: S06 sample covariance of trailing 252 daily returns scaled by 60
scenario_risk_distribution: 756-session aligned moving-block bootstrap of 60-session cross-sectional return blocks
execution: decision at signal close; next SPY session adjusted open; prior-close S04 liquidity; opening commission price
transaction_costs: existing S06 transaction_fee_helper.py: spread + market impact + IBKR commission; charged in NAV
eligibility: requires 756 complete prior daily returns, next-session open, and point-in-time fee context
risk_free: DGS3MO lagged one SPY session; compounded to 60 sessions for optimization and accrued daily in NAV
caution: The peer XGBoost exported signals are used directly; no retraining occurs.
The test period has been inspected previously and is not a pristine untouched holdout.
Stage-1 q is solved once per date and shared across Stage-2 utilities; this is a controlled ablation of Stage 2.
The common Stage-1 candidate set includes the union of prior holdings across utility portfolios to avoid utility-specific candidate-set drift.
Historical bootstrap scenarios are overlapping and therefore dependent; they represent an empirical scenario distribution, not independent observations.
Different utility functions have different numerical scales; compare resulting portfolios and realized performance, not raw utility values across functions.
The current mean-variance baseline uses the original 252-session covariance estimator; scenario-based alternatives use the 756-session moving-block bootstrap risk distribution.
